chapters.reason: The paper introduces a specialized training strategy (data construction, mapping hidden states to gist tokens, attention masks) to teach models to compress intermediate thoughts during reasoning, aligning with 'Training Strategies for Recurrent Reasoning'.

LightThinker enables latent reasoning capabilities (dynamic compression of thoughts) through targeted training on standard LLM architectures without explicit structural modifications, fitting 'Training-induced Recurrence'.

The method addresses efficiency bottlenecks in long reasoning chains by compressing intermediate tokens, indirectly relating to layer depth as a constraint on reasoning length, though not its primary focus.
